test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Occesion**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct** spelling of the word is "**Occasion**".
 
• **Occasion** means a **special event**.
 
 
• **Example: ***The family were colour-coordinated for the **occasion**. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate answer is "Occesion". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Humorous** - funny

 
 
• **Example:** *The show was **humourous**. *
 
 
 
• **Mysterious** - suspicious
 
 
• **Example:** *The man over there looks **mysterious**. *
 
 
 
• **Scissors** - a tool that helps to cut things, mostly paper. 
 
 
• **Example: ***Open this parcel using **scissors***.
